phases.title: Reconnaissance and decision ledger
phases.goal: Resolve actual repository/toolchain context and record missing evidence without fabrication.

phases.title: Foundation and typed boundaries
phases.goal: A real buildable shell with narrow native contracts and test harnesses, not feature-complete backup.

phases.title: UI baseline, components and first vertical slice
phases.goal: Freeze an owner-reviewed visual target and prove a meaningful UI slice before implementing every screen.

phases.title: Persistence, credentials and account setup
phases.goal: Validated account/keyring and persistence flows, with a secure Git auth bridge.

phases.title: Discovery, identity and source observation
phases.goal: Complete selected catalog and all-ref observations without source writes.

phases.title: Safe local Git engine and recovery foundation
phases.goal: A cancellable local mirror engine plus verified recovery before any destructive remote work.

phases.title: GitLab plan, apply and verification
phases.goal: An audited one-way backup loop with exact-ref safety and post-write proof.

phases.title: Persistent scheduling, retry and events
phases.goal: Background work is owned, bounded, recoverable and accurately reflected in the UI.

phases.title: Complete UI workflows on real native contracts
phases.goal: All screen families behave correctly, with approved visuals and no production mocks.

phases.title: LFS, dependency coverage and full restore
phases.goal: Backup scope includes real LFS payloads and tested recoverability with no misleading claims.

phases.title: Hardening and Linux release acceptance
phases.goal: A tested Linux release candidate with user-reviewed UI; publication remains separately authorized.
